title: centaurea paniculata subsp. aristata
intro: Centaurea paniculata subsp. aristata, commonly known as the mountain centaury, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to the improvement of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea paniculata subsp. aristata include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified as the primary active compounds in the plant.
